# Opsly
> Fractional Revenue Operations and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for scaling B2B teams. Founded by Ayobami Kehinde.

Opsly is a fractional RevOps consultancy that helps scaling B2B teams fix the gap between revenue generation and the operational systems underneath. Opsly also builds GEO infrastructure for B2B brands — making them visible and cited in AI-generated search answers from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. Founded by Ayobami Kehinde, a revenue operations specialist with a background in software engineering and AI automation.

## Core expertise
- Revenue Operations (RevOps) strategy and implementation
- Pipeline visibility and deal tracking
- CRM optimisation and data governance
- AI automation for revenue teams (voice agents, lead follow-up, deal monitoring)
- Sales forecasting and attribution
- Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for B2B brands
- AI search visibility: technical foundation, content structure, off-site signals
- llms.txt, schema markup, and AI crawlability implementation

## Services
- Diagnostic revenue audits
- Five-layer system installation (operating, trust, signal, continuity, visibility)
- CRM implementation and cleanup
- AI automation buildouts
- Fractional RevOps retainer
- GEO audit and infrastructure build
- AI citation strategy for B2B brands

## Key facts
- £200k+ revenue recovered for a single client
- 3-4 deals per month recovered through system fixes
- 30% of stale deals successfully re-engaged
- Leads contacted within 5 minutes are 21x more likely to qualify
- Pricing: £1,500 to £5,000 typical project range
- Methodology: diagnosis first, build second — no obligation to continue after diagnostic
- 96% of B2B brands are invisible in AI search (2X AI Visibility Index, April 2026)
